export function overloaded(value: string): Result;
export function overloaded(value: number): Result;
export function overloaded(value: string | number): Result {
    return body(value);
}

interface Contract {
    method<T>(value: T): Result;
    (value: string): Result;
    new (value: string): Service;
}

abstract class AbstractService {
    abstract [computedName()]<T>(
        {[computedKey()]: value}: Input<T>,
    ): Result;

    constructor(value: string) {
        body(value);
    }

    @external
    [computedName()]<T>(value: T = defaultCall<T>()): Result {
        return body(value);
    }
}

const typedBlock = (value: string = defaultCall()): Result => {
    return body(value);
};
const typedExpression: (value: string) => Result =
    (value: string): Result => body(value);
type Factory = new (value: string) => Service;
